_comment: Item definitions. category: material | lootbox | placeable | source | structure. Everything lives in the pocket universe: materials are matter in grid cells, and the rest are built in cells. atomicMass (materials, in u) makes a material a gas that spreads between cells, lighter ones faster (universe.json gas). Materials follow the cosmology: hydrogen and helium are primordial, while carbon and iron only come out of collapsing caches for now. Items with a lootTable are caches: they sit in a cell (or an irradiator's chamber) until opened. Irradiators (placeable with maxExposureStacks > 0) hold one cache and one radiation source, both built into them; sources name a radiation id from radiation.json. Structures are part of the pocket universe: actions create them and they can't be dismantled. An overdensity (structure with maxAmplitude > 0) yields the current epoch's yieldTable into its own cell every yieldSeconds, one roll per amplitude. stackSize only matters for uniqueness (1). opacity (0 to 1, default 1) is how solid the item draws: below 1 it is see-through, so an irradiator shows the cache and source inside. material (optional asset path, e.g. /Game/Materials/M_Ripple) overrides the shared world material for this item when the asset exists (docs/MATERIALS.md). The loot_box item is shown to players as the Quantum Cache (ids keep the old name).

items.tooltip: Primordial hydrogen: a lone proton, and three quarters of all the matter there will ever be.
Primordial helium, fused in the first few minutes. A quarter of all the matter there will ever be.
Forged when three helium nuclei fuse. No star has shone yet, so only the crush inside a collapsing cache is enough to make it.
The end of the fusion road: fusing iron costs energy instead of releasing it. Only the most compressed caches collapse this far.

Primordial gas crushed into a sealed cache in superposition: what's inside isn't decided until it's observed. Open it to collapse it, and its contents land in its cell. The crush fuses some of the gas into carbon and, rarely, iron.
A quantum ripple stretched to cosmic size. It's a little denser than its surroundings, so it gathers whatever matter the epoch has to offer into its cell. Each amplitude adds a roll to its yield.
A chamber as cool as a glowing gas cloud. Contains radiation up to tier 4 (microwaves). Build a cache and a radiation source into it.
A chamber as hot as a star's corona. Contains any radiation up to tier 7 (gamma). Build a cache and a radiation source into it.
Bathes a cache in visible light, which favours carbon: caches yield more carbon. Built into an irradiator.
Heats and cures what it shines on: caches get extra rolls. Built into an irradiator.
Ore extraction: caches yield more iron. Built into an irradiator.
Observation: collapses a cache early. Its contents are revealed and fixed, and nothing changes it after that. Built into an irradiator.
Mutation: caches may collapse into more caches. Built into a corona irradiator.
